templates.description: Activity-driven implementation of post-task validator dispatch per OpenSpec change 2026-04-26-validators-and-failure-modes (§7). Subscribes to lifecycle:task:completed and chains five tasks: (1) discover_validators — find activities consuming the parent task's outputShapes AND producing validation_result via the canonical `discoverByShapesQuery` impulse-resolve shape (mode=backward + output_shapes=[validation_result]); (2) select_validator_per_shape — pick a validator from the activity envelope using composition_score and Thompson α/β; (3) dispatch_validators — execute the chosen validator with the parent task's outputs as inputs; (4) propagate_failure_mode — when validation_result.passed === false, emit a failure_mode_propagation impulse carrying the structured verifier_negative failure_mode for the dispatcher to stamp on the parent trace; (5) learning_signal_write — record impulse_relevance + tool_argument_pattern signals for the parent task, gating executionSucceeded on validator outcome. As of 2026-04-26 the template uses dotted-path interpolation (e.g. {{lifecycle.taskId}}, {{lifecycle.executionId}}) — the interpolate regex was extended to /\{\{([\w]+(?:\.[\w]+)*)\}\}/g in iter 7 (activity.ts:6952). Task 1 uses the canonical `impulse-resolve` + `discoverByShapesQuery` pattern advertised by activity-api — zero minibob source changes (vessel-integration constraint).

prompt.template:
You are converting a discoverByShapesQuery result into a variant_selection_result impulse for the downstream activity dispatcher.

Input envelope (JSON): {{impulse:discover_validators_result}}
The envelope's `content` field (when delivered as the impulse-resolve response) is a JSON-stringified {activities: Activity[], total: number}. Each Activity has `id`, `name`, `output_shapes`, `input_shapes`, and may have `metrics` (Thompson α/β, success_rate) and `composition_score` ({alpha, beta} when mode=candidates_with_scores; null otherwise).

If total === 0 OR activities is empty, output: {"selected":null,"unbindable":true,"reason":"no validator candidates returned by discoverByShapesQuery"}

Otherwise pick the BEST candidate by:
1. If any candidate has composition_score (non-null), maximise composition_score.alpha / (composition_score.alpha + composition_score.beta).
2. Else maximise metrics.thompson_alpha / (metrics.thompson_alpha + metrics.thompson_beta).
3. Tie-break by metrics.total_executions DESC, then by `id` lexicographically.

Output EXACTLY (no markdown, no prose):
{"selected":{"activity_id":"<winner.id>","template_id":"<winner.id>"},"runner_ups":[{"activity_id":"<id>","template_id":"<id>"}, ...],"selection_method":"composition_score_or_thompson","unbindable":false}

No other fields. No commentary.

config._lifecycle_note: taskId/templateId/executionId/allImpulseIds/loadedImpulseIds/toolCallRecords use dotted-path interpolation against the lifecycle:task:completed payload. The interpolator JSON-stringifies array values when embedded as string leaves of resolver config; the resolver tolerates JSON.parse-able string-form arrays so the chain wires end-to-end. templateId is in the lifecycle payload. The hardcoded 'executionSucceeded: false' is a deliberate conservative default — the meta-activity fires post-completion specifically when validation may have failed; the parent task's intrinsic success is irrelevant to the validation-success signal. A future cleanup wires this to the validator's pass/fail outcome.
